notes: The head of 'preaching good tidings of' is genuinely contested — rule 66 glosses the εὐαγγελ- root 'good tidings' while rule 91's βλασφημέω precedent heads a comparable frame on the verb word — and the unit note names the alternative.
The trailing 'of' stays inside the verb's frame, as rule 91's 'to speak evil of' does, leaving εἰρήνην its own word.
